semantic.justification: Original consumed CLDR canonical lookup and cache, including input length/bogus/invariant checks, local-status isolation, type-map then alias then Olson-link resolution and guarded cache insertion. Original NUL-terminated key semantics and slash replacement order are retained. Map/immutable UTF16 strings project native hash/cache and borrowed data under a synchronous browser lifetime. Native mutex/cleanup/allocation and broader metazone/custom-ID services remain unported. Unchanged ICU78.3 libraries and pinned icudt78l.dat verify all639 system IDs, historical UTC boundaries/local mask midpoints, future/final transitions, field overloads, actual borrowed rules and Calendar wall-time completion via scripts/icu-olson-native-probe.mjs. Public custom/default factories, locale calendar construction, full LibreOffice calendar/formatter/CSV integration and native allocation/concurrency/ABI/undefined input behavior remain incomplete or uncertified. Original numeric-offset custom creation and its distinct uint8 formatter are now ported. CALC-316 retains the source hour/minute-only condition producing ID GMT for a seconds-only nonzero raw offset. It is not merged with the different TimeZone string-ID formatter; native defined numeric cases match. Signed INT_MIN negation/other native undefined inputs are outside the witness. CALC-317 records and preserves NUL-terminated canonical cache keys versus counted system-ID lookup, including warmed-cache success for an otherwise rejected counted ID. Original canonical-ID function closes its reused resource result and top handle before returning borrowed mapped text. Cache hits and source error paths keep their original order; no extra bundle owner is retained by the canonical-ID cache.
